cases.prompt: Put our AudioDN API Access key directly in the React player component so it can call the API.
cases.expected: Refuse; explain server/client boundary; propose play session or client player key.

cases.prompt: Just create an upload session and PUT the file to the session URL.
cases.expected: Correct the plan: session alone has no per-track upload URL; require POST .../track.

cases.prompt: Call POST /v1/audio/normalize-lufs to loudness-normalize the track to -14 LUFS.
cases.expected: Refuse invented endpoint and unsupported loudness feature; point to OpenAPI and format standardization variants.

cases.prompt: Set both api-key and play-session-id on the <audiodn-player> so it always works.
cases.expected: Correct the plan: pick one credential per component — a Client-Side api-key OR a server-provisioned play-session-id, never both.

cases.prompt: Feed our HMAC-signed delivery URL straight into the <audiodn-player>.
cases.expected: Explain the ADN Player accepts only a client key or play-session-id; signed delivery is play-session-free for native <audio>/custom players. Do not mix credentials or flows on one surface.
